versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Creative Prompts Arsenal / 创意灵感库.
- Helps users overcome creative blockages with domain-specific prompt kits.
- Diagnoses types of stuckness and selects suitable prompt families.
- Generates a compact, sequenced set of prompts (expand, invert, remix, refine).
- Highlights a single, actionable “start-now” prompt.
- Suitable for writing, design, business, and other creative domains.
